A comparison of access contracts, not a replica map or measured route. Shop 10’s home is eu-north; shop 20’s is eu-west. Regional-by-table deliberately gives this entire example table one home. GLOBAL describes suitable reference data, not a recommendation for frequently updated stock. Other replicas exist; the database survival goal separately governs voting placement. Eligible historical reads are outside this comparison.
